resources.comments: Teams governance - annual review of teams without an end date, and weekly report of teams without owners
resources.name: GovernanceAnnualReview

inputs.where: @and(equals(item()?['GroupType'], 'Team'), not(equals(item()?['ExcludeFromGovernance'], true)), empty(item()?['EndDate']), equals(item()?['GovernanceStatus'], 'Active'), not(empty(json(if(empty(item()?['OwnersJSON']), '[]', item()?['OwnersJSON'])))), if(empty(item()?['LastAnnualReviewDate']), and(not(empty(item()?['GroupCreatedDateTime'])), lessOrEquals(ticks(addDays(coalesce(item()?['GroupCreatedDateTime'], utcNow()), int(coalesce(outputs('Settings')?['GovernanceAnnualReviewDays'], '365')))), ticks(utcNow()))), lessOrEquals(ticks(addDays(coalesce(item()?['LastAnnualReviewDate'], utcNow()), int(coalesce(outputs('Settings')?['GovernanceAnnualReviewDays'], '365')))), ticks(utcNow()))))

body.Title: Tørrkjøring: annual-review (varsel)
body.LogDetails: GovernanceDryRun=true - ingenting er sendt eller endret. Ville utført: annual-review (varsel). Status: @{items('For_each_annual_review')?['GovernanceStatus']}, sluttdato: @{items('For_each_annual_review')?['EndDate']}.

body.Title: Årlig gjennomgang sendt
